messages:
maya-pm: Heads up — long-term roadmap doc needs a 'routing invariants' section for product. Wanted to surface key customer-driven items.

trent-arch: Good call. Invariants I'd propose: 1) deterministic latency tiers; 2) observable fallback behavior; 3) opt-in data isolation.

ivo-eng: Implementation caveat: deterministic latency implies some headroom provisioning and admission control per lane. That's a capacity/cost tradeoff.

nina-ops: Ops note: admission control must integrate with SLO alerting and automated scaling to avoid manual intervention.

frank-product: Customers asking for data residency + physical isolation. We should map which of our regions can operate as isolation zones and any legal constraints.

eval-bot: Eval run: isolation-lane/regression-suite v3 — pass (no regressions)

maya-pm: Proposed product commitment checklist: SLA drafting, region compatibility matrix, tiered pricing, migration path, and compliance pilot program.

trent-arch: Also need to codify routing templates for different failure modes: latency-first, cost-first, and compliance-first.

ivo-eng: Suggest template examples:
```
latency-first: prefer low-latency region, fallback fastest alternative, aggressive kv-cache warming
cost-first: prefer quantized model variants, allow higher p95 under threshold, batch aggressively
compliance-first: restrict to pinned region, no cross-region fallback, dedicated KV partitions
```

nina-ops: For compliance-first template, also require audit logs, KMS integration, and manual escalation paths.

frank-product: Let's ensure pricing includes dedicated capacity reservation fees for compliance-first. Also flag that some models may not be available in all variants.

maya-pm: Action items: Ivo -> routing template library prototype; Trent -> invariants doc; Nina -> ops checklist; Frank -> pilot customer list & pricing sketch. We'll review Friday.

maya-pm: Quick poll: soft isolation GA first? (react with :one: for soft-first, :two: for hard-first)

reactions:  :one: x5, :two: x1

maya-pm: Looks like soft-first wins. We'll still run a parallel hard isolation pilot.

maya-pm: OK locking this thread into the PRD notes. Thanks all.
